## Details

<a id="save_fight_background"></a>
### [`save_fight_background`](../../../../src/screen/fight_area.asm#L6) `$8C41`

*routine*

Copies the fight area of the bitmap to $b098: character rows 14-21, columns 4-35, 256 bytes for each row. The copy uses $b098-$ba57 with $140 bytes between the rows. It overwrites the loaded bytes at $b3e8-$ba57.

- **Called from:** [`start`](../init/init.md#start), [`change_scene`](scene.md#change_scene)
- **Reads:** [`bitmap_arena_row14`](../graphics/background_bitmap.md#bitmap_arena_row14), [`bitmap_arena_row15`](../graphics/background_bitmap.md#bitmap_arena_row15), [`bitmap_arena_row16`](../graphics/background_bitmap.md#bitmap_arena_row16), [`bitmap_arena_row17`](../graphics/background_bitmap.md#bitmap_arena_row17), [`bitmap_arena_row18`](../graphics/background_bitmap.md#bitmap_arena_row18), [`bitmap_arena_row19`](../graphics/background_bitmap.md#bitmap_arena_row19), [`bitmap_arena_row20`](../graphics/background_bitmap.md#bitmap_arena_row20), [`bitmap_arena_row21`](../graphics/background_bitmap.md#bitmap_arena_row21)
- **Writes:** [`bg_strip0`](../../memory-map.md#bg_strip0), [`bg_strip1`](../../memory-map.md#bg_strip1), [`bg_strip2`](../../memory-map.md#bg_strip2), [`bg_strip3`](../data/fight_background.md#bg_strip3), [`bg_strip4`](../data/fight_background.md#bg_strip4), [`bg_strip5`](../data/fight_background.md#bg_strip5), [`bg_strip6`](../data/fight_background.md#bg_strip6), [`bg_strip7`](../data/fight_background.md#bg_strip7)

<a id="restore_work_bitmap"></a>
### [`restore_work_bitmap`](../../../../src/screen/fight_area.asm#L29) `$8C77`

*routine*

Copies the saved background at $b098 into the work bitmap at $a698. This erases the fighters of the last frame.

- **Called from:** [`$80D0`](../../../../src/main/main_loop.asm#L14), [`update_fighters_frame`](../story/final_stage.md#update_fighters_frame), [`change_scene`](scene.md#change_scene), [`quit_to_demo`](../main/quit_to_demo.md#quit_to_demo)
